pick.headline: Croatia launches Operation Storm against Krajina
pick.fbis: The East Europe Daily Report of August 4, 1995, listed a long run of Croatia items on the Krajina offensive: Tudjman announcing "military-police measures," Serb lines broken at 30 sites, Belgrade radio on the shelling of Knin, and Akashi calling the offensive hard to understand.
